{{Quote|Commander Resner, let us dispense with the pleasantries. It is well known that there had been a significant increase in Rebel activity in the Trax Sector. What steps are you taking to beat down the Rebel scum?|Admiral Heggel|<ref name="GK" />}}
'''Heggel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="GK" /> Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|31|Heggel}}</ref> Heggel held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]]<ref name="GK" /> and was assigned to command the [[Trax Sector Group]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Concerned about [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] activity throughout the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]], Heggel confronted [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Resner]] about what he was doing to combat it.<ref name="GK" />
